33626-the-career-of-leonard-wood.creator: Corinne Roosevelt Robinson
33626-the-career-of-leonard-wood.description: A book by Corinne Roosevelt Robinson. lowing the Great War it is well upon beginning anything--even a modest biographical sketch--to consider a few elementals and distinguish them from the changing unessentials, to keep a sound basis of sense and not be led into hysteria, to look carefully again at the beams of our house and not be deceived into thinking that the plaster and the wall paper are the supports of the building.

Brothers share each other's joys as well as each other's sorrows. The reason of the change is, that Irish Catholic intelligence does not find its way abroad.

arxiv-1704-01004.title: Influence of Super-Horizon Modes on Correlation Functions during Inflation
arxiv-1704-01004.creator: Anne-Sylvie Deutsch
arxiv-1704-01004.description: Abstract Coupling between sub- and super-Hubble modes can affect the locally observed statistics of our universe. In the context of Quasi-Single Field Inflation, we can compute correlation functions and derive the influence of those unobservable modes on observed correlation functions as well as on the inferred cosmological parameters.

arxiv-1805-01257.title: Dimerization in honeycomb Na 2 RuO 3 under pressure: a DFT study
arxiv-1805-01257.creator: D. D. Gazizova ∗+, A. V. Ushakov +, S. V. Streltsov ∗+
arxiv-1805-01257.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by D. D. Gazizova ∗+, A. V. Ushakov +, S. V. Streltsov ∗+. The structural properties of Na 2 RuO 3 under pressure are studied using density functional theory within the generalized gradient approximation (GGA). We found that one may expect a structural transition at ∼ \sim 3 GPa. This structure at the high-pressure phase is exactly the same as the low-temperature structure of Li 2 RuO 3 (at ambient pressure) and is characterized by the P ​ 2 1 / m P2_{1}/m space group.

arxiv-1811-05144.title: Sensitivity Analysis of a Stationary Point Set Map under Total Perturbations. Part 1: Lipschitzian Stability
arxiv-1811-05144.creator: Duong Thi Kim Huyen, Jen-Chih Yao, Nguyen Dong Yen
arxiv-1811-05144.description: Abstract By applying some theorems of Levy and Mordukhovich (Math Program 99: 311–327, 2004 ) and other related results, we estimate the Fréchet coderivative and the Mordukhovich coderivative of the stationary point set map of a smooth parametric optimization problem with one smooth functional constraint under total perturbations.

arxiv-2209-11703.title: Multivariate Wasserstein Functional Connectivity for Autism Screening
arxiv-2209-11703.creator: Oleg Kachan, Alexander Bernstein
arxiv-2209-11703.description: Abstract Most approaches to the estimation of brain functional connectivity from the functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data rely on computing some measure of statistical dependence, or more generally, a distance between univariate representative time series of regions of interest (ROIs) consisting of multiple voxels.

arxiv-2303-13636.title: PPG-based Heart Rate Estimation with Efficient Sensor Sampling and Learning Models Thanks: This project was funded in part by The University of Texas at San Antonio, Office of the Vice President for Research, Economic Development & Knowledge Enterprise. This work appeared at the 2022 IEEE Internatio
arxiv-2303-13636.creator: Yuntong Zhang 1 , Jingye Xu 1 , Mimi Xie 1 , Wei Wang 1 , Keying Ye 2 , Jing Wang 3 and Dakai Zhu 1
arxiv-2303-13636.description: Abstract Recent studies showed that Photoplethysmography (PPG) sensors embedded in wearable devices can estimate heart rate (HR) with high accuracy. However, despite of prior research efforts, applying PPG sensor based HR estimation to embedded devices still faces challenges due to the energy-intensive high-frequency PPG sampling and the resource-intensive machine-learning models.

arxiv-2308-15981.title: Microstructured plastic scintillators for beam profiling in medical accelerators
arxiv-2308-15981.creator: Veronica Leccese, Michele Caldara, Samuele Bisi, Marcello Pagano, Simone Gargiulo, Carlotta Trigila, Arnaud Bertsch, Alessandro Mapelli, Fabrizio Carbone
arxiv-2308-15981.description: Abstract A novel beam profiler based on microstructured scintillation resin is presented. The detector consists of a bundle of waveguides, with an active area of 30 × \times 30 mm 2 and a pitch of 400 µm, obtained by molding a scintillating resin into a microfabricated PDMS mold.

arxiv-2309-10550.title: Addressing the Scalability Bottleneck of Semantic Technologies at Bosch
arxiv-2309-10550.creator: Diego Rincon-Yanez, Mohamed H. Gad-Elrab, Daria Stepanova, Kien Trung Tran, Cuong Chu Xuan, Baifan Zhou, Evgeny Karlamov
arxiv-2309-10550.description: Abstract 1 Introduction At the heart of smart manufacturing is real-time semi-automatic decision-making. Such decisions are vital for optimizing production lines, e.g., reducing resource consumption, improving the quality of discrete manufacturing operations, and optimizing the actual products, e.g., optimizing the sampling rate for measuring product dimensions during production.

arxiv-2311-01270.title: People Make Better Edits: Measuring the Efficacy of LLM-Generated Counterfactually Augmented Data for Harmful Language Detection
arxiv-2311-01270.creator: Indira Sen, Dennis Assenmacher, Mattia Samory, Isabelle Augenstein, Wil van der Aalst, Claudia Wagner
arxiv-2311-01270.description: Abstract NLP models are used in a variety of critical social computing tasks, such as detecting sexist, racist, or otherwise hateful content. Therefore, it is imperative that these models are robust to spurious features. Past work has attempted to tackle such spurious features using training data augmentation, including Counterfactually Augmented Data (CADs).

arxiv-2504-01511.title: A computational framework for evaluating tire-asphalt hysteretic friction including pavement roughness
arxiv-2504-01511.creator: Ivana Ban, Jacopo Bonari, Marco Paggi
arxiv-2504-01511.description: Abstract Pavement surface textures obtained by a photogrammetry-based method for data acquisition and analysis are employed to investigate if related roughness descriptors are comparable to the frictional performance evaluated by finite element analysis. Pavement surface profiles are obtained from 3D digital surface models created with Close-Range Orthogonal Photogrammetry.

arxiv-2511-10506.title: Frequency Spectra of Isolated Laser Pulse Envelopes
arxiv-2511-10506.creator: L. H. Ford, Brian Fu
arxiv-2511-10506.description: Abstract This paper will deal with isolated laser pulses, those which last for a finite time interval and whose envelope function is strictly zero outside of this interval. We numerically calculate the Fourier transform of this function and study its asymptotic behavior at high frequencies.

britannica-1911-placenta.description: Article 'Placenta' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Before each menstrual period, during the child-bearing age of a woman, the mucous membrane of the uterus hypertrophies, and, at the period, is cast off and renewed, but if a fertilized ovum reaches the uterus the casting off is postponed until the birth of the child.

pmc-10685202.title: Precipitation pattern alters the effects of nitrogen deposition on the growth of alien species Robinia pseudoacacia
pmc-10685202.creator: Xiao Wang, Xiao Guo, Wenli Ding, Ning Du, Weihua Guo, Jiayin Pang
pmc-10685202.description: AimsNitrogen (N) supply and precipitation pattern (amount and frequency) both affect plant growth. However, N deposition is increasing and precipitation regimes are changing in the context of global change. An experiment was conducted to access how the growth of Robinia pseudoacacia, a widely distributed and cultivated N2-fixing alien species, is affected by both the pattern of precipitation and N supplies.

pmc-10752201.title: ﻿Metaphase chromosomes of five Neotropical species of the genus Drosophila (Diptera, Drosophilidae)
pmc-10752201.creator: Doris Vela, Erika Villavicencio
pmc-10752201.description: ﻿AbstractThe mitotic metaphases of five Andean species of genus Drosophila are described for the first time. The evolutionary and interspecific genetic relationships within three Neotropical Drosophila species groups are analyzed. The diploid chromosome number for each species is as follows: D.cashapamba Céspedes et Rafael, 2012 2n = 6 (2V, 1J) (X = J, Y = R), D.

pmc-11589004.title: Youth engagement in global conservation governance
pmc-11589004.creator: Samantha S Sithole, Gretchen M Walters, Philile Mbatha, Frank Matose
pmc-11589004.description: Youth are increasingly recognized for their important role in shaping environmental decisions surrounding conservation. Regrettably, youth who are crucial decision‐makers are often excluded from environmental governance spaces due to structural barriers, both economic and political. As highlighted by recent environmental justice literature, this marginalization hinders their active participation in the decision‐making process.

pmc-12411346.title: In Defense of Applied Behavior Analysis and Evidence-Based Practice
pmc-12411346.creator: Jason Travers, Matt Tincani
pmc-12411346.description: This commentary critically appraises attacks on applied behavior analysis (ABA) from outside and—increasingly—within the field. Commonly repeated attacks are that ABA is coercive and suppresses individual identity, aligns with the medical model, causes trauma, and, in more extreme cases, constitutes abuse.

pmc-12469723.title: The Impact of Smoking-Associated Genetic Variants on Post-Exercise Heart Rate
pmc-12469723.creator: Habib Al Ashkar, Nihad Kharrat Helu, Nora Kovacs, Szilvia Fiatal, Roza Adany, Peter Piko, Giuseppe D’Antona
pmc-12469723.description: Smoking has a well-established impact on cardiovascular health, notably through elevated resting heart rate and impaired autonomic regulation—both key risk factors. While nicotine’s acute effects are well documented, the influence of smoking-related genetic variants on heart rate (HR) responses remains unclear. This study investigated the association between selected smoking-related single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and HR dynamics following physical exertion.

pmc-12495287.title: A challenging case of angioproliferative Castleman's disease in the mediastinum
pmc-12495287.creator: Thanh Thuy Phan, Minh Hung Dong, Thu Phuong Phan, Van Giap Vu
pmc-12495287.description: Castleman disease (CD) is a rare lymphoproliferative disorder, most often presenting as a solitary hypervascular mediastinal mass and classified clinically into unicentric (UCD) and multicentric (MCD) forms, with histopathologic subtypes including hyalinized vascular, plasma cell, mixed and HHV-8-associated variants. Surgical resection remains both diagnostic and therapeutic, but significant intraoperative hemorrhage is a known risk given the tumor's vascularity.

pmc-12537716.title: Neurolinguistic and acoustic analysis of articulatory impairments in Arabic speech disorders
pmc-12537716.creator: Jeehaan Algaraady, Mohammad Mahyoob, Mohammad Zubair Khan
pmc-12537716.description: BackgroundPharyngeal sounds, integral to Arabic phonetics, require precise vocal tract coordination, posing significant challenges for individuals with speech disorders.ObjectiveThis study investigates the neurolinguistic and acoustic characteristics of pharyngeal sound production in Arabic speakers with speech impairments, aiming to elucidate the impact of neurological disruptions on articulatory precision.

pmc-12573745.title: Ion Size Effects on the Thermodynamic, Kinetic, and Mechanical Properties during Ion Exchange in Solid-State Electrolytes
pmc-12573745.creator: Harsh D. Jagad, Stephen J. Harris, Brian W. Sheldon, Yue Qi
pmc-12573745.description: Ion exchange offers a pathway to impose residual compressive stresses to mitigate the electro-chemo-mechanical cracking of solid-state electrolytes such as lithium lanthanum zirconium oxide. This study uses a coupled multiscale framework (integrating density functional theory (DFT), molecular dynamics (MD), and continuum modeling) to examine how exchange ion size influences stress, diffusion, fracture toughness, and electronic properties.

pmc-12610170.title: Chronic State and Relationship to Humans Influence How Horses Decode Emotions in Human Voices: A Brain and Behavior Study
pmc-12610170.creator: Serenella d’Ingeo, Marcello Siniscalchi, Angelo Quaranta, Hugo Cousillas, Martine Hausberger
pmc-12610170.description: Simple SummaryUnderstanding how animals perceive human emotions is important for improving their welfare and our interactions with them. In this study, we examined how two groups of horses reacted to human voices expressing different emotions, such as happiness, anger, fear, and sadness.

pmc-12666737.title: SQ House Dust Mite Sublingual Immunotherapy Tablet in Children With Allergic Asthma: A Randomised Phase III Trial
pmc-12666737.creator: Graham Roberts, Jocelyne Just, Hendrik Nolte, Ole Holm Hels, Andrzej Emeryk, Carmen Vidal
pmc-12666737.description: BackgroundIn children, house dust mite (HDM) sensitisation is a contributing factor for developing allergic asthma. HDM allergen immunotherapy has demonstrated efficacy and safety in adults with allergic asthma; however, evidence for its use in children is limited. MT‐11 evaluated the efficacy and safety of the SQ HDM sublingual immunotherapy (SLIT) tablet in children (5–17 years) with HDM allergic asthma.

pmc-12757253.title: Optimal dose and type of exercise to improve cognitive function in adults with major depressive disorder: a systematic review and Bayesian model-based network meta-analysis
pmc-12757253.creator: Jiarong Ge, Qiyi Wang, Shimeng Wang, Xuan Xiong, Yifei Zhai
pmc-12757253.description: IntroductionCognitive impairment is a core feature of major depressive disorder (MDD) that often persists during remission, significantly affecting psychosocial functioning. While exercise is known to alleviate depressive symptoms, its specific impact on cognitive domains remains variable. This study aims to evaluate the dose–response relationship and comparative effectiveness of different types of exercise interventions on cognitive function in adults with MDD.

pmc-12844388.title: Cell Adhesion and Cytotoxicity Assessment of Collagen-Coated Electrospun PCL Membranes Functionalized with Silver Nanoparticles
pmc-12844388.creator: Chiara Goisis, Davide Porrelli, Gianluca Turco, Barbara Medagli, Giovanni Papa, Martin Iurilli
pmc-12844388.description: Chronic and complex wounds require biomaterials that are both cytocompatible and antimicrobial. Herein, electrospun polycaprolactone (PCL) nanofiber membranes were coated with Type I collagen and functionalized with silver nanoparticles (AgNPs). The main objective was to assess fibroblast adhesion, proliferation, and cytotoxicity.

pmc-12973226.title: Spin-regulated d–p hybridization enables high energy density and wide temperature operation of Na3V2(PO4)2O2F-type cathodes for sodium-ion batteries
pmc-12973226.creator: Qiang Fu, Qin He, Fangxiang Song, Xianquan Ao, Hanxiao Liu, Yang Cao, Rong Li, Keliang Wang, Jing Li, Cuiqin Li, Yao Xiao
pmc-12973226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As a member of the sodium superionic conductor (NASICON) family, Na3V2(PO4)2O2F (NVPOF) has attracted tremendous research interest owing to its high operating voltage and excellent structural stability. It is well established that NVPOF cathodes are electron-ion mixed conductors. However, improving electron or ionic conductivity via a single approach fails to effectively enhance the rapid sodium storage capability, which impedes their practical application in sodium-ion batteries. Herein, the electronic and ionic conductivities were enhanced through a transition-metal/fluorine dual-doping method.

pmc-13163716.title: Admission Biomarkers as Predictors of Mortality in Comatose Patients in the Intensive Care Unit: A Retrospective Pilot Study
pmc-13163716.creator: Pompiliu Mircea Bogdan, Roxana Elena Bogdan-Goroftei, Alina Plesea-Condratovici, Adina Oana Armencia, Letitia Doina Duceac, Camer Salim, Cristian Gutu, Manuela Arbune, Lavinia-Alexandra Moroianu, Constantin Marinel Vlase, Monica Mihaela Scutariu, Alina Mihaela Calin
pmc-13163716.description: Background: Intensive care units (ICUs) provide management of critically ill patients requiring continuous monitoring and complex therapeutic interventions. The aim of this study was to analyze the clinical and biological characteristics associated with mortality in patients admitted to the intensive care unit.

pmc-13210508.title: Combining Deep Learning Mechanisms to Predict Interests from Gaze
pmc-13210508.creator: Aoba Izumi, Fumiko Harada, Hiromitsu Shimakawa
pmc-13210508.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This paper proposes a model to predict users’ personal interests from their gaze. Current image processing technologies enable us to identify each user’s gaze and pupil diameter. However, they cannot identify user interests. The model uses deep learning technologies. It consists of mechanisms to handle the two kinds of gaze: one specific to individuals and the other common to many people. Its training method utilizes the human property that user interests in objects in vision affect their gaze.

pmc-13221669.title: The value of arthroplasty registries: from surveillance to societal impact
pmc-13221669.creator: Ola ROLFSON, John McKIE, Anne LÜBBEKE
pmc-13221669.description: Info — Since early 2025, Acta Orthopaedica has served as the official publisher of the International Society of Arthroplasty Registries (ISAR) congresses. Founded in 2005, ISAR (https://www.isarhome.org) is a global organization comprising national, regional, and institutional joint replacement registries. Its mission is to improve outcomes for patients undergoing joint replacement surgery worldwide.

pmc-13505129.title: Comparative analysis of inflammatory and metabolic biomarkers in PGDM and GDM pregnancies
pmc-13505129.creator: Aydın Ocal, Sinem Tekin, Hatice Atalmis, Olgu Icten Bafali, Hamdiye Acar, Pelin Kulan, Can Bilginer, Filiz Yarsilikal Guleroglu, Emine Ufuk Büyükkaya Ocal, Ali Cetin
pmc-13505129.description: BackgroundPregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) and gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) are associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes through inflammatory and metabolic dysregulation. This study compared serum levels of pro-early placental insulin-like growth factor (pro-EPIL), galectin-3, sirtuin-1 (SIRT-1), matrix metalloproteinase-10 (MMP-10), chemerin, and interleukin-33 (IL-33) in diabetic pregnancies and explored their inter-correlations.

pmc-13545143.title: Evaluation of a Self-Guided Eye Movement Training for Individuals with Central Vision Loss
pmc-13545143.creator: Patricia Grant, Janet P Szlyk, Meesa Royster, Charlotte C Jackson, William Seiple

pmc-13548269.title: Development and temporal validation of a clinical prediction model to identify bacterial infection in hospitalised patients with systemic lupus erythematosus
pmc-13548269.creator: Rong-qia Wu, Ze-xin Zheng, Qiong-bing Zheng, Hong-jin Liang, Yao Gong, Dan-min Wang, Zhi-duo Hou, Ling Lin
pmc-13548269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo develop and temporally validate a clinical prediction model for identifying bacterial infection (BI) among hospitalised patients with SLE.MethodsWe retrospectively included hospitalised patients with SLE admitted for BI or active disease between January 2023 and January 2026. Admissions from January 2023 to January 2025 formed the training cohort, and admissions from February 2025 to January 2026 formed the temporal validation cohort. BI included infection with or without concomitant active SLE; non-infected active (NA) SLE was the comparator.
